testCaseName: EF-REG-011 - Locale-stable currency, compact amount, and date formatting

steps.expectedResult: Indian grouping is used; 840000 renders ₹8.4L and 12000000 renders ₹1.2Cr.
steps.actualResult: Indian grouping was observed on fresh connected Dashboard, Finance, and detail values; Finance displayed the current compact value ₹5.4L. The canonical ₹8.4L and ₹1.2Cr fixtures were absent from the connected dataset, so those exact outputs were not directly observed.
steps.evidenceNote: Fresh formatting screenshots are embedded in the finalized per-step trace; no standalone PNG was generated.

steps.expectedResult: 2026-08-18 displays 18 Aug 2026 without a previous-day shift; invalid date text remains unchanged.
steps.actualResult: Existing connected fixture EF2-1235-N displayed 18 Aug 2026. Runtime was en-IN / Asia/Calcutta; alternate-timezone behavior and invalid-date UI input were not safely exercisable.
steps.evidenceNote: Fresh date verification is embedded in the finalized per-step trace; no standalone PNG was generated.

evidenceLimitations: Canonical ₹8.4L and ₹1.2Cr fixtures were not present in the connected dataset during this fresh run.
The browser runtime was en-IN / Asia/Calcutta; alternate timezone behavior was not independently exercised.
Invalid date text cannot be entered through the connected read-only UI.
No standalone PNG screenshots were generated; fresh screenshots are embedded in finalized trace artifacts.
